scope: Continue the 1960 teachers-union legislative/legal network from the State Council anchor, test contemporary press against later synthesis, and expand non-presidential actor/event leads without attributing institutional action to individuals absent primary proof.

confirmed_findings.finding: National Archives' official State Council agenda list places Education Ministry item 287 (교육공무원법 중 개정 법률(안), 3 pages) and item 288 (교직단체법(안), 15 pages) together at the 37th State Council meeting on 1960-10-08 in file BA0084253.
confirmed_findings.source: 국가기록원 국무회의 안건 목록집 I, p.234 / PDF page 16
confirmed_findings.open_question: Agenda presence does not establish disposition. Retrieve the bill texts and meeting minutes/result.

confirmed_findings.finding: Dong-A Ilbo's 1960-09-27 evening edition article index includes '法制室에 회부 敎職團體法案', independently narrowing the bill's administrative path to a Legal Office review stage immediately after the Education Ministry draft date reported by KDemo.
confirmed_findings.open_question: Open the page image/article text and identify whether 法制室 means the State Council Legal Office, the referral date, requested revisions, and responsible officials.

confirmed_findings.finding: KDemo states that the special committee reviewing the Labor Union Act amendment withdrew the amendment on 1960-09-29 after nationwide resistance. Contemporary KDemo event material independently records hundreds of regional teachers-union representatives demonstrating at the National Assembly against illegalization on 1960-09-29.
confirmed_findings.open_question: Retrieve the special committee minutes to identify the formal mover of withdrawal, vote/procedure, and whether the bill was withdrawn, rejected, or otherwise disposed.

confirmed_findings.finding: KDemo's event archive records a 1960-10-11 Daegu delegates meeting of the Gyeongbuk Teachers Union resolving to demand abandonment of the Teachers' Organization Bill and threatening a third hunger strike if it were submitted to the National Assembly.
confirmed_findings.open_question: Compare the resolution text with the State Council disposition to test whether pressure preceded a deferment/withdrawal or merely coincided with it.

confirmed_findings.finding: KDemo's event archive, citing Yeongnam Ilbo 1960-10-26, reports that the ICFTU sent the Korean teachers-union federation a letter supporting teachers' union-organizing rights under Korean constitutional/labor law and international law. This creates an external provenance line rather than a Korean-government or union-only claim.
confirmed_findings.open_question: Retrieve the original ICFTU letter or international archive copy, sender/signatory, date, legal authorities cited, and exact recipient organization name.

confirmed_findings.finding: Dong-A Ilbo's 1960-08-26 evening edition index reports that the House of Councillors resolved to question the teachers-union dispute (敎組紛糾質疑). This opens a second parliamentary chamber research line separate from the House of Representatives debate already tracked.
confirmed_findings.open_question: Retrieve the 1960-08-26 Councillors minutes, movers, questions, ministers answering, and any resolution text.

confirmed_findings.finding: Dong-A Ilbo 1960-08-25 records the newly formed Chang Myon cabinet's administrative reorganization and personnel context, including Education Minister Oh Cheon-seok and Justice Minister Cho Jae-cheon profiles, but the index alone does not establish their personal direction of the teachers-union legal actions.
confirmed_findings.open_question: Use cabinet minutes, ministry correspondence and parliamentary answers before assigning personal decision roles.

event_updates.open_question: Referral mechanics and requested legal review.
Exact resolution text and causal relation to government disposition.
Separate court holding, governor appeal question, and State Council response using primary records.

adversarial_checks: The State Council agenda proves tabling, not approval.
The Education Ministry as proposer does not prove Oh Cheon-seok personally drafted or ordered the bill.
The Chang Myon cabinet context does not prove Chang personally directed the bill.
The 1960-09-27 Legal Office referral suggests an administrative review chain but does not establish favorable legal approval.
KDemo's 1961-02-12 abandonment date still lacks an official disposal record.
The Labor Union Act amendment and Teachers' Organization Bill remain distinct legislative tracks.
The simultaneous Education Public Officials Act amendment cannot yet be labeled a companion bill.
The Daegu High Court decision cannot be summarized as a holding that the union itself was legal until the decision text is read.
The ICFTU letter is an external legal/political position, not binding Korean law.
The 1960-10-11 union threat may correlate with bill non-enactment but does not by itself prove causation.

execution_counts.counting_note: Search snippets were not counted as documents. The National Archives agenda PDF is counted once despite multiple searches/finds. Dong-A date pages are counted as distinct contemporary newspaper issue indexes, not as full article texts.
